title: Label chips have their own soft colours
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData and open the Inbox
Find rows with the Clients, Receipts, Hiring or Atlas labels and a category chip
Search for one of those labels' subjects (/) and look at the result rows
Switch View › Appearance to Dark, then try Paper and Midnight
expected: Each label chip is a capsule tinted with its own colour, with text of the same hue (darker in light themes, lighter in dark themes); a label has the same colour in every row and in search results. Important, VIP and +N are grey tints; a Superhuman category not imported yet is muted grey. Every chip reads easily, also on the selected and checked rows.
